title: Launch a dev mission
sourceDocs: Existing READY STATE or DIE trees (sw_pull, precheck, mobile_app, scout_issue, scout_goal)

sl_p0.help: Check the truck on the ticket, read the test procedure, and note the software tag and stack mode it calls for.
sl_p0.done_when: The ticket's truck matches this truck and the test procedure is clear enough to run.
sl_p0.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Purpose (a test procedure must be on the ticket before dispatch)

sl_esc_disp_truck.text: The VO ticket is assigned to a different truck. Dispatch fixes the assignment.

sl_esc_disp_proc.text: The ticket has no test procedure, or it can't be run as written. Dispatch gets it fixed with the requestor before you start.
sl_esc_disp_proc.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Purpose and Complex Requests
sl_esc_disp_proc.handoffNote: Per the SOP, a test procedure must be on the ticket before it's dispatched. Complex requests go to #ask-dev-test-ops.

sl_p1.text: Confirm the truck is in the correct environment
sl_p1.help: In Slack, send yourself a DM with /checkenv. Dev missions use Pre-production, or Staging if the ticket says so. If the environment gets changed, cold start afterward.
sl_p1.done_when: /checkenv confirms the truck is in the correct environment.

sl_esc_env.phrase: Truck is in the wrong cloud environment, needs moving to the correct one
details: Screenshot: the /checkenv result showing the current environment.
sl_esc_env.text: Stop. The truck is in the wrong environment. Open a VRE thread and paste the summary below.
sl_esc_env.handoffNote: Request: put this vehicle in the correct cloud environment. Once it's in the correct environment, the VO will perform a Cold Start. Reply in thread when done.

sl_p2.text: Connect shore ethernet and bring computes up
sl_p2.help: Connect shore ethernet. Turn on the computes and boot the Aurora Driver.
sl_p2.done_when: Scout shows the truck connected, and it's on the Office Network.
sl_p2.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure; Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Truck prep 5.1–5.2

steps: Check every power cutoff switch is in the run position.
Check pECU (and rECU, if present) are on.
Wait for Scout to reconnect.
Check every power cutoff switch is in the run position.
Wait for Scout to reconnect.
sl_c1.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Truck prep 5.2 (check power cutoff switches before escalating to VRE)

sl_c2.text: Cold start once, then recheck Scout
steps: TODO: platform cold-start sequence from SOP.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
sl_c2.source: TS: DTP-104301 · launch.json ln_cs platform sequences · VO site practice (Oct 2026)
sl_c2.help: Do one cold start only. In DTP-113007 and DTP-112133, repeated cold starts didn't help because the truck was in the wrong environment.

steps: Apply parking brake.
Note: You no longer need to be in the idle stack to cold start. You only need to be in idle when removing logging disks.
Press and hold the Compute Power Button for 5 seconds. PWR indicators blink red.
Wait for both PWR indicators to slow-blink green.
Press and hold the Engine Start Button to turn off the vehicle.
Turn the primary battery bank switch OFF.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch OFF.
Ensure both TMS LEDs are off. If on, cycle the battery switches again.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes.
Ensure the DBW Disconnect is in the up/released position.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch ON.
Connect shore power if needed.
Turn the primary battery bank switch ON.
Shore power only: press Engine Start twice. Vehicle power: hold the Engine Start Button.
Ensure both TMS LEDs show amber or green.
Press the drive height recall button.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. It fast-blinks green, then goes steady.
If it takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Note: You no longer need to be in the idle stack to cold start. You only need to be in idle when removing logging disks.
Turn ignition key OFF. The LED stays solid green for about 150 seconds, flashes red for about 10 seconds, then turns off.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes after the LED is off.
Perform System Start Up.
Ensure the DBW Cutoff Switch is in the up/released position.
Engine power: start the engine and keep the ignition key in ON.
Shore power: confirm the shore power switch is off, connect shore power to the vehicle DC receptacle, turn the shore power switch on, then turn the ignition key to ON.
Ensure the Compute Power Button is flashing once per second (system ready to boot).
Press and release the Compute Power Button. The LED fast-blinks green, then burns steadily.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Note: You no longer need to be in the idle stack to cold start. You only need to be in idle when removing logging disks.
Turn ignition key OFF.
If on shore power: turn the shore power unit switch OFF and disconnect shore power from the vehicle.
Wait a minimum of 2 minutes.
Perform System Start Up.
Press the DBW Disconnect switch.
Start the engine. If on shore power: plug in shore power and turn the key to ON for 5 seconds.
Immediately release the DBW Disconnect button and ensure it is in the up/released position.
Wait for both PWR indicators on the LSI to slow-blink green.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. PWR indicators fast-blink green, then burn steadily.
If the system takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
FG2.1 only: perform the TBS check.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.

sl_disk1.text: Reseat both logging disks and power cycle
steps: Only swap or reseat disks in the idle stack.
Reseat both logging disks.
Power cycle the computes and check both disk lights.
sl_disk1.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 3.1; Truck prep 5.2

sl_disk2.text: Reseat the disks one more time
steps: Reseat both logging disks again.
Check both disk lights.
sl_disk2.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Truck prep 5.2 (if still not lit, reseat again and escalate to VRE)

sl_esc_conn.phrase: Truck won't connect in TApp after the switch check and a cold start
details: Screenshot: TApp showing the truck disconnected.
sl_esc_conn.text: Truck won't connect after the switch check and one cold start.
sl_esc_conn.handoffNote: Check the vehicle's cloud environment first. In three recent tickets, 'not connecting' turned out to be the wrong environment, and a cold start fixed it after VRE changed it.

sl_esc_disk.phrase: Logging disk light still off after two reseats
details: Photo: the logging disk lights. Say which one is dark.
sl_esc_disk.text: Logging disk light still off after two reseats.

sl_esc_net.text: The truck isn't on the Office Network with shore ethernet connected.
sl_esc_net.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure
sl_esc_net.handoffNote: Tag the requestor from the VO ticket in this thread.

sl_p3.text: Put the ticket's software on the truck
sl_p3.help: If the ticket needs a deploy, pull it in Scout. If remote deploy is on, wait for Dispatch to assign the tag, then start the deploy in the Aurora Mobile App. Cold start afterward.
sl_p3.done_when: Scout shows the software the ticket calls for, and the truck is back up after the cold start.
sl_p3.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure

sl_p4.text: Does the ticket call for DTV?
sl_p4.help: Only run Drive-Thru Verification if the ticket or VRE asks for it.
sl_p4.done_when: DTV isn't needed, or it passed.
sl_p4.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Drive Thru Verification

sl_p5.text: Clear annotations and start the mission
sl_p5.help: Clear previous annotations. Press Start Mission for Autonomous, or use Change Stack Mode in the expanded Mission panel for the mode the ticket names. Pre-mission checks run on their own.
sl_p5.done_when: The mission is started and a log is running in the right stack mode.
sl_p5.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure and Shadow Autonomy Procedure

options.label: Module red, Scout crashed or froze

sl_p6.help: Localize and clear as many checklist items as you can. Trailer pose checklists can be ignored when bobtail. Ask the requestor or VRE which others are okay to ignore.
sl_p6.done_when: The truck is localized, and every checklist item left is cleared or approved to ignore.
sl_p6.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure and Shadow Autonomy Procedure

steps: If you're starting from a launch pad, make sure you're on the pad itself, not in front of it or at a staging spot.
Line up with the painted lines.
Immobilize again: parking brake, wait 4 seconds, Neutral.
sl_loc1.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 6.3; TS: DTP-109800, DTP-96816, DTP-110741, DTP-105621

steps: Drive at least 165 ft with at least one 90° turn. Avoid unnecessary stops.
Check Scout shows the truck localized.
sl_loc2.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 6.2; TS: DTP-107859, DTP-110850, DTP-112377

sl_esc_loc.text: The truck still won't localize after realigning and a loop.
sl_esc_loc.handoffNote: Tag the requestor from the VO ticket in this thread.

sl_esc_check.text: A checklist item won't clear and isn't approved to ignore.
sl_esc_check.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure
sl_esc_check.handoffNote: Tag the requestor from the VO ticket in this thread. List each checklist item exactly as Scout shows it.

sl_p7.text: Set the goal and start the test
sl_p7.help: Set the goal. If the mission needs autonomy on a dev build, do disengagement checks first.
sl_p7.done_when: The test is running as the ticket describes.
sl_p7.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure

sl_esc_ready.text: No ready state for autonomy after the goal is set.
sl_esc_ready.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure
sl_esc_ready.handoffNote: Tag the requestor from the VO ticket in this thread.

sl_done.text: Test running. When you're done: stop the mission (or swap to IDLE), copy Scout notes into Results, update the ticket status, and post the offload screenshot in the dispatch thread.
sl_done.source: Standard Dev Ops Test Procedures (Nov 13, 2026), Standard Dev Test Procedure
